exact_blocker: The official Historic England point-GIS catalogue explicitly states that listed buildings are represented by a single point in the centre of the building footprint. A point is not a physical footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon, and this metadata source window exposes no record-level Exeter footprint geometry.
